text: What’s on your priority list this year? In October, the State Department of Education gave the OK for school districts to use content from PragerU if approved by their school boards. Since then, your department has received at least three letters of concern from Idaho’s federally recognized tribes, and on Thursday at the Council on Indian Affairs, tribal leaders said even if their local districts don’t use these videos, any district using them could cause harm. Are you concerned? Have you responded to the tribes’ letters? After hearing this feedback from the tribes, are you considering rescinding that approval of PragerU? Graduation requirements – Digital literacy is so important, but that means getting rid of speech. Are we worried about kids and their ability to communicate? You’ve said before that Idaho is already a great state for school choice. We have open enrollment at public schools, we have charter schools, we have liberal allowances for home school. This year, the governor said for the first time that he’s willing to entertain public money going for private education, with some parameters. Are you on the same page? If so -- What changed? Anything else on your plate? (weighted funding – What characteristics do you look at?)
